lines.text: Adonijah asks Bathsheba to request Abishag the Shunammite as his wife from King Solomon.
Solomon seats Bathsheba at his right hand, hears her request, and has Benaiah strike Adonijah down.
Solomon sends Abiathar to his fields in Hebron and banishes him from the priesthood, fulfilling the word spoken against Eli's house.
Joab flees to the tent of the LORD, refuses to come out, and Benaiah kills him; Benaiah takes his place over the army.
Solomon forbids Shimei to cross the Brook Kishon, and when Shimei goes to Gath, Benaiah strikes him down.
